benchmark.methodology: Actual Electron Canvas2D,960x360 CSSpx,DPR1; production validation/index/renderer/hit/command functions. Fixture generation excluded;5warmups,30samples. Initial includes validation/index/first draw/forced layout. Scroll/zoom mutate viewport, drag is preview plus render; command commit measures pure validated move. JS submission excludes physical presentation, storage and full session/DOM work.

limits: Single Linux Obsidian1.15.0 environment; no physical audible latency/device loopback measurement
No Windows/macOS, screen-reader, hardware high-DPI or musical popout certification
Same-pitch overlaps remain unsupported; distinct-pitch chords/polyphony verified
Ten real start/stop cycles count tracked resources, not a heap leak certification
Canvas benchmark measures JS submission; pointer benchmark includes roll/session history, excludes full inspector and storage
